audience.description: Same values as AUDIENCES in src/platform/lib/reviewQueue.ts, the Events and Posts audience field.

coverage.description: Where an item sits against coverage.md: core area, nearby catchment, citywide or countywide with a resident benefit, outside, or not yet known.

documentId.description: A Payload document id (numeric with SQLite), unique only within its collection.

fetchStrategy.description: How a source is fetched: direct (plain GET, the default) or direct-then-playwright (a headless browser only when the direct fetch trips a fallback trigger, README.md).

fetchUsed.description: In a run log: the last strategy tried for the source (direct, or playwright after a fallback); none when the source wasn't polled.
